title: 第一卷 第8章 全场震动，长老召见
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
“极品天灵根！”

    短短五个字，如同九天惊雷，狠狠炸在所有外门弟子耳畔。

    整片广场死寂一瞬。

    下一秒，滔天哗然彻底炸开！

    所有人瞪大双眼，死死盯着角落白发佝偻的苏玄尘。

    脸上的戏谑、轻视、讥讽，尽数凝固，继而被极致的难以置信取代。

    他们方才还在嘲笑、调侃这个百岁老朽不自量力，痴心妄想踏足仙途。

    可转眼，宗门执事当众官宣——

    这位百岁老者，竟是千年难遇的极品天灵根！

    荒唐！

    离谱！

    颠覆认知！

    修仙界亘古不变的铁律，便是少年筑基，气血鼎盛。

    六岁测灵、十岁入道、十五筑基，才是正统仙苗。

    百岁之人，肉身朽坏、寿元枯竭、经脉僵硬，本是彻底断绝仙路的废体。

    谁能想到，如此一副必死躯壳内，藏着整个青州最顶级的修仙资质！

    “不可能！绝对不可能！”

    “我青州百年以来，从未出过极品天灵根！怎么会在一个百岁老头身上？”

    “是不是搞错了？测灵玉盘出错了吧！”

    无数弟子失声惊呼，心态彻底炸裂。

    他们寒窗苦修数年、十数年，拼尽努力，大多只是普通杂灵根、三灵根。

    资质稍好的，也不过中品、上品灵根，已是外门佼佼者。

    可这个活了一百年、风烛残年的老者，一开局，就是他们这辈子都企及不到的天花板！

    人群前方，刚刚还放狠话的赵山，身躯骤然僵住。

    他瞳孔猛缩，脸色瞬间惨白，浑身冰凉。

    极品天灵根！

    原来自己嘲讽、欺压、当众挑衅的老朽，是宗门万年不遇的绝世天才！

    可笑！

    太可笑了！

    自己方才还大言不惭，扬言要在试炼中收拾对方。

    现在看来，如同跳梁小丑一般滑稽可悲。

    极品天灵根修士，同阶无敌，越阶杀敌如喝水吃饭。
content_en:
"The best heavenly spirit root!"

    Just five words, like thunder from the sky, exploded in the ears of all the outer disciples.

    The entire square fell silent for a moment.

    The next second, the uproar completely exploded!

    Everyone stared at the white-haired Su Xuanchen in the corner with wide eyes.

    The teasing, contempt, and sarcasm on his face were all frozen, and then replaced by extreme disbelief.

    Just now, they were still laughing and teasing this hundred-year-old man for overestimating his abilities and wishing to embark on the path to immortality.

    But in the blink of an eye, the sect’s deacon made an official announcement in front of everyone——

    This 100-year-old man actually has the highest quality Heavenly Spiritual Root that is rare to find in a thousand years!

    absurd!

    Outrageous!

    Subvert cognition!

    The eternal and unchanging iron law in the world of immortality is that young people build the foundation and their energy and blood are at their peak.

    Those who test spirits at the age of six, enter Taoism at the age of ten, and build the foundation at the age of fifteen are the orthodox immortal seedlings.

    A hundred-year-old person's body is decayed, his longevity is exhausted, and his meridians are stiff. He is a waste body that has completely cut off the path to immortality.

    Who would have thought that within such a mortal body, there was the most outstanding talent for cultivating immortals in Qingzhou!

    "Impossible! Absolutely impossible!"

    "In the past hundred years in Qingzhou, we have never produced the best Tianling Root! How could it be found in a hundred-year-old man?"

    "Is there a mistake? There must be something wrong with the spirit-testing jade plate!"

    Countless disciples exclaimed, their mentality completely shattered.

    They have been practicing hard for several years or more than ten years, and they have worked hard, but most of them only have ordinary miscellaneous spiritual roots and three spiritual roots.

    He has slightly better qualifications, but he only has middle-grade or high-grade spiritual roots, and he is already a leader in the outer sect.

    But this old man who has lived for a hundred years and is in his final years, from the beginning, is a ceiling that they will never reach in their lifetime!

    In front of the crowd, Zhao Shan, who had spoken harshly just now, suddenly froze.

    His pupils shrank sharply, his face instantly turned pale, and his whole body became cold.

    The best heavenly spirit root!

    It turns out that the old man who he mocked, bullied, and publicly provoked is a peerless genius that the sect has never seen in thousands of years!

    ridiculous!

    How ridiculous!

    Just now, he was brazen and threatened to deal with the other party in the trial.

    Now it seems as funny and sad as a clown.

    The best Tianlinggen cultivator, invincible at the same level, killing enemies across levels is like drinking water and eating.
